patch_description: Combines the current greedy+move local search with the swap phase from the higher-scoring crossover inspiration. After greedy placement (sorted by req_rate/slo, placed on GPU minimizing resulting KVPR), the local search repeatedly tries moving a model off the worst GPU, and if no move improves the max KVPR, tries swapping models between the worst GPU and other GPUs. This was the best-performing variant (combined score 25.83).
